items.raw_excerpt: Charity wax-off highlight as priests and publicans line up

items.raw_excerpt: Tourists looking to get a picture of canola fields are often told to steer clear, but one central Victorian farm is welcoming them with open arms and has turned the attraction into a popular agritourism event.
items.summary_en: Tourists usually cannot enter canola fields for photos. But one farm in Victoria lets visitors come in. The farm has become a popular tourist spot.

items.raw_excerpt: Amarnath Yatra resumes after six-day weather halt, with over 6,000 pilgrims departing Jammu for Baltal base camp.
items.summary_en: The Amarnath Yatra, a famous Hindu pilgrimage in Kashmir, started again after storms blocked the mountain path for six days. Over 6,000 pilgrims left the city of Jammu heading for the Baltal base camp. Officials say the weather has improved enough for the journey to continue safely.

items.title_en: Amarnath pilgrimage resumes after six-day rain break

items.raw_excerpt: The ACT party wants to give hunters a "real stake in managing and looking after our conservation estate".
items.summary_en: The ACT Party proposes giving hunters control over game animals on New Zealand conservation land. The party argues hunters should have a real stake in managing the conservation estate. This would change current government management to hunter-led management.

items.title_en: ACT Party wants hunters to manage game animals on conservation land

items.raw_excerpt: Two additional suspected cases of H5 bird flu have been detected in South Australia.
items.summary_en: Two additional suspected cases of H5 bird flu have been detected in South Australia. One case was found at a metropolitan beach, marking the first detection at such a location. Health authorities are monitoring the situation closely.

items.raw_excerpt: Not many people know that it wasn't Alberta, but a small town in southwestern Ontario, that was at the centre of a historic petroleum rush that helpe…
items.summary_en: A small town called Petrolia in southwestern Ontario was at the centre of Canada's first petroleum rush. It produced oil long before Alberta became famous for it. The town helped shape Canada's oil industry.

items.raw_excerpt: KOZHIKODE: For years, the statement “I’m from Wayanad” has elicited a predictable smile and familiar joke: “So, you move from one place to another using vines?”
items.summary_en: Zeenath Sherbin from Wayanad, Kerala has officially earned her pilot license. For years, people joked that people from Wayanad move around using vines. Now Zeenath is proving them wrong by taking to the skies.
